name: Consistent Isovertex Definition via Edge-Trees
definition: A method to define the position of an isovertex on an octree edge consistently by traversing down the edge-tree to a leaf node with value 1, ensuring watertightness by avoiding ambiguous positions when multiple sign changes occur on a coarse edge.
summary: Consistent Isovertex Definition via Edge-Trees resolves ambiguous isovertex positions on octree edges by traversing an edge-tree to a unique leaf, ensuring watertight isosurface extraction without refining the tree or modifying vertex values.
